label: Start here - the first steps of this portal

params.name: rows

default.label: Sign up your firm and get it approved
default.say: My firm: its details and papers, then Send - the portal admin approves it. Filing your own return? Choose Individual / HUF: it opens at once.

default.label: Add your team
default.say: Partners, reviewers and preparers - each with a role that decides what they may do.

default.label: Start a new filing
default.say: Pick who the return is for and drop the documents in - the client is made from them, and only what is missing is asked.

default.label: Upload Form 16, the AIS or a bank statement
default.say: Intake & map reads each file and maps its lines to the return.

default.label: Compute the return
default.say: Compute & close works the tax out under both regimes, from the mapped figures.

default.label: Sign off, file and close the year
default.say: Mark it filed with the acknowledgement number - the year closes.

default.label: Start your filing
default.say: Say what applies, drop in Form 16, the AIS and 26AS - My return fills in what it can.

default.label: Check your return and download its JSON
default.say: My return checks it against the official rules; you upload the JSON on the income-tax portal yourself.

params.label: each step: id, label, say (words), href (its screen), the done test - fact (a fact core/startcard.py counts, or a list summed) and/or call (a pattern over the person's own successful requests) reaching at_least; grant (left out for a role without it - a desk of one has no team), kinds (only these kinds of firm)

params.name: screens
params.label: the screens the card is drawn on (the landing first)

A seam: every domain writes its own. 2026-10-11: the first work step is New filing (#/wizard): 'Start a new filing' for a firm, 'Start your filing' for a self-filer; the card shows on the wizard too.
